load_context.meaning: Optional load trace attached by the gate when context is present.

ok.meaning: Whether the admin indicator sample was produced.

power.meaning: Power watts, sources, time and source signal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed attendance and operation refusals; the handler requires document and attendance headers. Runtime collector errors are mapped to a fixed signal, not passed through. Successful samples carry individual indicator signals inside their blocks. Common gate refusals are not listed.
